name: @feimacode/open-design-agent-kit-codex
description: Generates this repo's root-level .agents/skills/ directory — Codex CLI's own skill-discovery convention — from the same curated OpenDesign entries and overview skill the Claude Code plugin uses. Not an npm package; the generated .agents/skills/ is what a Codex user copies into their own project (or points Codex at directly if working from within this repo).
